generationLineage.promptText: Create one original photorealistic editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Fictional East Asian woman founder of a B2B AI software company, early thirties, straight shoulder-length black hair tucked behind one ear, calm focused face, natural real skin detail, simple structured deep blue top. She sits at a white table explaining a product decision to an off-camera interviewer, a closed unbranded notebook and one pen visible, no readable writing or screens. Medium portrait with full head and natural hands, 85mm-equivalent view, frontal camera slightly offset to right by 10degrees. Layered contemporary room: pale matte wall close, a doorway revealing a softly lit navy meeting area 3 metres behind. Large soft left key, restrained window reflection, accurate exposure and gentle contrast. Crisp subject, soft spatial background, premium but human and practical. Plenty of uncluttered white negative space on left. No text, logos, UI, final photo frame, watermark, real-person resemblance, cyberpunk or plastic skin. This fictional media is for a labeled design specimen.
